rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout19 gate failed invalid (injury turns skipped the requested tool; two invented capabilities) and two prompt changes made in response (injury advice first but still use the requested tool; never claim a capability the knowledge base lacks); never use it to tune.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout20.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout19 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
